archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Prompt compression can accidentally weaken literal output contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Code Reviewer template, regenerated artifacts, and aggregator prompt for contract drift. Verify required headings, severity values, focus-area values, sidecar schema fields, OOS handling, and empty-merge attestation behavior remain intact. Focus on subtle wording changes that could alter reviewer or aggregator obligations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
